text: The Senior Vice President, Development, CreateTO will provide a verbal update on progress that has been made on the Housing Now Initiative since the previous Board meeting. A portion of the update is confidential and will require a closed session as it relates to negotiations carried on or to be carried on by or on behalf of the Board of Directors of CreateTO.
The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Received the report (September 28, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO for information.
